Use case: stylized-concept. GeoGuard production ART DESIGN, not imported, not runtime screenshot. Creamy off-white negative space, warm dark brown rounded outlines, soft matte sticker illustration, sage/mint, honey, coral, icy blue and muted lavender accents. Clean professional art bible board with legible concise typography, panel gutters and cell IDs. NO character bodies, NO monsters, NO faces, NO guns, NO barrels, NO independent unit bodies on this board. Any cross, arrows, guide boxes, text and divisions are annotations, not exported art. No photorealism, neon, shiny metal or new gameplay. Reference image is style reference only; never copy the characters into effect sheets.
Header "GeoGuard / B01 FRIENDLY SHOT SOURCES", subline "10 appearances / 3 motion kinds / DESIGN — NOT IMPORTED".
Exactly ten labeled cells in 2 columns x 5 rows, read left-to-right each row. In every cell show TWO SEPARATE isolated swatches: a projectile at center pivot P with tiny +X arrow facing right, and a detached short muzzle flash with pivot M on LEFT REAR EDGE and arrow to right. No connector between them. Both are solid clean sticker silhouettes; use subtle shape differences inside the same kind. Kind basic = small seed capsule; cannon = round seed orb; sniper = thin elongated seed lance. No trajectory arc, no object bodies, no barrels.
Cells exact labels:
"P01 PLAYER / basic": honey compact capsule; honey short puff. Tiny note "No body gun".
"P02 BASIC / basic": sage round capsule; honey rounded flash.
"P03 CANNON / cannon": round honey-sage orb; broad rounded flash.
"P04 SNIPER / sniper": slim sage lance; narrow flare.
"P05 RAPID / basic": shorter mint capsule; tiny rapid puff, only ONE projectile swatch.
"P06 MORTAR / cannon": broader terracotta-sage round orb; soft broad puff. Note "Straight logic motion".
"P07 FROST / basic": short icy-blue seed; small icy flash; NO orbiting ice ball.
"P08 RAIL / sniper": lavender-sage slim lance; narrow warm flash; only ONE projectile swatch.
"P09 BURST / basic": coral-tipped short sage seed; rounded flash; ONE projectile swatch and ONE flash, no cluster pretending count. Note "4 fixed muzzle anchors / runtime count".
"P10 SENTINEL / basic": deep sage blunt seed; compact warm flash.
Footer: "P = projectile center | M = emitter attachment | +X = local forward"
Footer: "Birth stays at logical owner center. Speed, damage, spread and count stay in code."
Never invent charge-up layers, explosive stages or new attacks. Shapes are cosmetic source variants, not 10 new projectile kinds. Plenty whitespace; body-free effect sheet.
